Number of extreme poor borrowers enrolled in the DSHP is at least 550,000 Data Source: Annual development effectiveness monitoring reports from CARD Actual value:

Output: CARD's ability to promote and deliver more inclusive finance to poor women and the extreme poor in the Philippines increased Indicator: Annual loans disbursed to women borrowers increased to at least PHP20 billion Data Source: Annual development effectiveness monitoring reports from CARD Actual value:
